title: Can We Trust a Black-box LLM? LLM Untrustworthy Boundary Detection via Bias-Diffusion and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical identification of biased topic boundaries within LLMs using reinforcement learning and knowledge graphs. While it discusses fairness and acknowledges religion as a category of bias in existing work, its own methodology and dataset (LBID) are focused on general thematic domains such as politics, economy, and AI, rather than a dedicated evaluation of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
